properties.displayName: SCF - Manual attestation for usage of Data Management tool for data discovery and classification and protection
properties.description: This policy requires manual attestation to validate that technical and procedural safeguards, including encryption, DLP tools, and endpoint protection, are applied through the approved Data Management tool to prevent or detect potential data leakage.
